input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Section 8.2-8.3 is the only renewal mechanic in the document (no other auto-renewal or uplift language appears). It meets the preferred position in full: renewal terms are successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year renewal), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (within the 30-day preferred window, well inside the 60-day fallback ceiling), Vendor must remind Customer at least sixty days before renewal, and renewal uplift is capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent. Because automatic renewal satisfies every conditional element, mutual written agreement is not required. The reminder-failure tolling and ninety days' notice of an increase are additional Customer protections. No redline needed.
